subject: Weekly exec prep: QBR deck inputs + ops flags (wins / risks / asks)
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Exec Leadership <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly exec prep: QBR deck inputs + ops flags (wins / risks / asks)

Team —

Quick weekly note ahead of Wednesday’s prep slot. I pulled together the current QBR deck draft (attached) and flagged the items we should call out in the leadership section. Summary below — please skim and push any edits into the drive link.

WINS
- Hosted API: 12% QoQ request efficiency improvement after batching tweaks; unit costs down ~6% per token on the production tier.
- Dedicated: two new reserved-capacity pilots signed (SignalCloud & one stealth), expected start-of-billing next month.
- Console: rollout of token-level breakdown reached 80% of customers in beta; early feedback positive.

RISKS / OPEN QUESTIONS
- Private deployments: on-prem appliance release slipped by ~3 weeks due to an HSM integration issue; this affects our Sep onboardings for regulated customers.
- ACME procurement: contract redlines outstanding (pricing floor + data residency clause). Procurement has escalated pricing exceptions internally — may need credits.
- Capacity: one regional fleet (eu-west-2) faces a GPU supply shortfall for a ten-day window in mid-Sep — may need to route traffic or activate burst capacity.

ASKS (short and actionable)
- Laura: can you sign off on the leadership slide copy by Tue COB? I kept the language concise, callouts are in the notes.
- Jonas: Ops needs two priority decisions — approve the 10% temporary credits for ACME to keep cadence, and authorize purchase of short-term cloud capacity (estimate attached).
- Marissa: please confirm the customer outreach plan for SignalCloud pilot kickoff (owner, date, one-pager).

Attachments: QBR_2026_Q3_deck_draft_v2.pptx, contract_redline_acme_2026-08.pdf

Thanks — I’ll consolidate feedback into the deck Tues morning.

—David
David Kim
Chief Product Officer, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Exec Leadership <leadership@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly exec prep: QBR deck inputs + ops flags (wins / risks / asks)

Thanks, David — good summary. A couple quick notes: 

1) Leadership slide: I can take it and tighten the narrative, but need the one-liner on customer impact from the batching change (metrics + one customer quote) — can you paste that in here or into the slide notes?
2) Private appliance delay: need a short blurb for the QBR about mitigation and expected ship date; recommend we call out the HSM vendor dependency as cause and the contingency (KMS-only path) we’ll support temporarily.

I’ll try to get the slide copy back to you by Tue 5pm PT.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Operations
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly exec prep: QBR deck inputs + ops flags (wins / risks / asks)

Looping in operations specifics:

- ACME contract: procurement@acme-corp.com asked for a 12% introductory credit for the first 2 months. Our bottom-line hit is ~8k ARR for the pilot; recommendation: approve up to 10% credit and require a shortened payment SLA (Net30 -> Net15). If leadership prefers no credit we should prepare an escalation playbook for the sales team.
- eu-west-2 GPU shortfall: temporary cloud burst estimate attached in the deck (~$14k/week) to cover capacity until supply stabilizes. We can also route low-priority jobs to a secondary region with minimal perf impact.

Decision requests: 1) Approve 10% ACME credit (or provide alternative). 2) Approve up to $50k emergency cloud burst budget for Sep (to be used only if supply delays exceed 72 hours).

Jonas
Director, Infrastructure
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Exec Leadership <leadership@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly exec prep: QBR deck inputs + ops flags (wins / risks / asks)

Quick operational updates on the asks: 

- SignalCloud kickoff: owner assigned — I’ll lead outreach. Proposed date: 2026-09-07. I’ll circulate the one-pager and internal runbook by Wed morning.
- ACME negotiation: legal has redlined the contract (see attachment) — I recommend we offer a 10% pilot credit and request Net15 to close quickly; I’ll coordinate with Sales to prepare the DocuSign envelope once approved.
- Capacity buffer: I’ll earmark $30k as a hold; if leadership approves Jonas’ $50k ask we’ll unrestrict to that ceiling.

I’ll drop short bullets into the deck and send an updated slide by Tue AM.

—Marissa
Sr. Director, Customer Success
